card.name: Word-initial L in medical terms
card.fires_on: The letter L starting a new word that is split off from its rest, such as lichens, liver, lymphocytic, lactic, lansoprazole, liothyronine and lung. It appears in running text and in all-caps warnings.

modes.label: Lowercase l
modes.description: A lowercase l begins a word such as lichens, lactic or lansoprazole.

modes.label: Capital L
modes.description: A capital L begins a medical term, often in headings or all-caps warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: DRUG-INDUCED<< L>>IVER INJURY AND L

card.writes: It promotes mostly unrelated tokens and suppresses 'hand' forms, so there is no clear link to the L pattern.
card.plain: It fires when a word starting with L, like liver or lactic, is broken so that the L stands alone.
